Definition: to carry (literally or figuratively), or (reflexively) be burdensome; specifically, to be gravid
BiblicalUsage: 1) to bear, bear a load, drag oneself along; 1a) (Qal) to bear (a load); 1b) (Pual) laden (participle); 1c)(Hithpael) to make oneself a burden, drag oneself along
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
